title: Sterilizing world physics so others can't catch up
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Sterilizing world physics so others can't catch up, about recent decades at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: One possibility is that one of the reasons we kicked all of the Americans out of our physics programs and science programs is that we wanted to sterilize the world so that it didn't catch up to us what we'd already done.

plain: A mathematician named Eric Weinstein, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, offers a possibility about why Americans were pushed out of US physics and science programmes in recent decades. He suggests the goal may have been to "sterilize" the world's physics so that no one else could catch up to what the US had already secretly achieved, which would mean breakthroughs are being hidden on purpose.
